description: This file contains test code for the 'mod_staticfile' module of the web server, including functions to test static file serving, handling of HTTP headers like If-Modified-Since and ETag, and the process of serving static files. It sets up a temporary file, configures a request, and runs various assertions to verify correct behavior.

classes.name: request_st
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request and response context, including headers, physical path, status, and other request-specific data.

classes.name: plugin_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for the static file module, including options for etags, pathinfo handling, and exclusions.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ void test_mod_staticfile_reset(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Resets the request state to prepare for a new test, clearing headers and response parameters.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ void run_http_response_send_file(request_st * const r,int line,int status,const char * desc)
methods.description: Calls the function to send a static file and aborts if the response status does not match the expected.

methods.name: void test_http_response_send_file(request_st * const r,time_t lmtime)
methods.description: Tests various scenarios of serving static files, including different header conditions and file states, verifying correct HTTP status codes and headers.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ void run_mod_staticfile_process(request_st * const r,plugin_config * const pconf,int line,int status,const char * desc)
methods.description: Runs the static file process handler and checks if the response status and return code match expected values.

methods.name: void test_mod_staticfile_process(request_st * const r,plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Tests the static file processing with different pathinfo and extension exclude configurations.

methods.name: void test_mod_staticfile(void)
methods.description: Main test function that sets up a temporary file, initializes request, runs static file tests, and cleans up resources.
